item.title: Fukuoka Yatai: Open-Air Food Stalls — Guide
item.description: Fukuoka is famous for its yatai — small, open-air food stalls that set up along the streets each evening, forming an atmospheric night-time dining scene found nowhere else in Japan on this scale. As dusk falls, the stalls appear along the Nakasu riverside, in Tenjin and elsewhere, each with a counter and stools seating around eight to ten people beneath a canopy. You perch on a stool, order from the chef right in front of you, and eat elbow-to-elbow with locals and travellers.
